## About
Custom World Auto Body is a body and paint shop on S Irwindale Ave in Azusa. We handle collision repair, frame work, paint jobs and classic car body repair, on foreign, domestic, exotic and classic vehicles.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 39 reviews on Google. One reviewer whose truck was hit from the side told us other shops wanted to replace the panel, and we were able to fix it instead.
If your car needs work, call us or fill out the request form with your vehicle and the area that's damaged, and we'll get back to you.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Collision repair from minor dents to frame work, to get your vehicle back on the road.
- Auto body painting: A new coat of paint or a customized paint job to give your car a fresh look.
- Classic car body repair: Careful body work for classic cars from a trained staff that appreciates older vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance claims?
A: Yes. Insurance claims are welcome here.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We are licensed, insured and bonded.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: We're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and closed Sunday.
